description: Contributed to three enterprise-grade projects within SLT-Mobitel's Digital Platform Division: an advertisement module, an enterprise portal revamp, and a biometric authentication system. Worked across the full stack using React, Node.js, and MongoDB while gaining hands-on experience in API testing, security testing, Agile practices, and formal documentation.
highlights: Conducted API testing using Postman across multiple microservices to validate endpoint contracts, status codes, and response payloads.
Performed security testing with OWASP ZAP, identifying and documenting potential vulnerabilities in the biometric authentication system.
Participated in Agile sprint ceremonies — daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
Authored technical documentation and handover notes for completed modules.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams during weekly review sessions with senior engineers.
qaHighlights: API testing with Postman (contract, status, payload validation)
Structured test case authoring for functional & regression cycles
